about_the_game:
Elixir of Moonglow

Once upon a time, under the moonlight glow, a girl named Ella opened her eyes to the world. By her side was Umbra, a loyal wolf and her dearest friend. Together, they wandered through glowing caves, towering mountains, and lush oasis pools, as Ella gathered ingredient, brew potions as an Alchemist Apprentice.

And so, Ella took a peek by the window, as the first chapter of her story began

Uncover the Truth with your companion

Summon Umbra to clear thorns, scare off critters, or to carry you across rivers. Umbra isn’t just helpful, he’s your loyal companion, a friend, learning together what life means in this world

Become the Best Alchemist you can be

Learn to become the best alchemist in town. Combine tangy, juicy, and whimsical ingredients to unlock tools and uncover secrets.

Explore Multiple Diverse Biome

Traverse a world of beautiful hand-drawn scenery, unique biomes, and unforgettable landmarks. Discover glowing caves, lush valleys, and quiet corners where magic lingers and every detail invites exploration

Play it on your own time

Play on your own phase, there are no lives to lose. Explore freely

Enjoy a cozy couch game where the whole family can enjoy.

Wishlist now to uncover the story of Ella and Umbra

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / macOS 10.14+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 360 (2 GB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit / macOS 11+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.
